items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well even a band like Paul Whiteman... [INTERVIEWEE] Steve Brown. Right. Another New Orleans man.

ctx.x: Changed the whole band. Yeah. So when somebody like Sammy Price says that jazz started in New York, it's ridiculous because the record's refuted. The Henderson band before Louie was so stiff. Well, it didn't sound to me any different than a white man practically. It's part of the tonality, you know.
Well even a band like Paul Whiteman, you can feel the difference in the rhythm when you hear the bass player.

Steve Brown. Right. Another New Orleans man. Every band had had anything the same. Yeah. Yes sir, I can go along 100%. Maybe we'll stop this time. Yeah, that's everything I wanted to say anyway. I just want to bring out the individual thing. Jim Robinson on Climax Ray. Unless Ed's got something else. We've got a minute to do. If you think of anything Ed, do you want to ask if it still kind of bothers you?
